variable {p}

@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_filter {s : Finset α} {a : α} : a ∈ s.filter p ↔ a ∈ s ∧ p a :=
  Multiset.mem_filter
proof_logic: For each direction, peel the actual input filter by Finset.mem_filter.mp, construct membership in the corresponding side of the original hsource using mem_filter.mpr, apply hp.mp or hp.mpr, peel the output filter, and reconstruct the target membership. The resulting conjunction predicates coincide by unfolding only S/sourceRegion definitionally. No simp normalization of either filter or its implicit decidable implementation is required. The original hsource remains the only arithmetic/domain licence.
